explanation: Isobars join places with equal air pressure. When they crowd together, pressure changes sharply over a short distance, which drives strong winds.

claims.text: Closely spaced isobars on a weather map indicate strong winds.
Closely spaced isobars do not by themselves indicate heavy snow, clear skies or thick fog.
Isobars are lines joining places of equal atmospheric pressure.
A steep change in pressure over a short distance drives strong winds.
